svg.text: RDNA 4 (GFX12) Wave32 — Register Layout: No Lane Mirroring
FP16 input → FP32 accumulator, 16×16×16 tile · All 32 lanes carry distinct operand data
Lanes 0–15 · K = 0..7 · 8 unique FP16 values per lane
Lanes 16–31 · K = 8..15 · 8 unique FP16 values per lane (NOT mirrors)
✓ All 32 lanes carry unique operand data — no wasted registers
A / B Operand (a_frag, b_frag — 8 FP16 per lane):
mn = lane % 16 // m-row for A, n-col for B (same index)
C / D Accumulator (c_frag, d_frag — 8 FP32 per lane):
⚠ Key Pitfall: A/B layout ≠ D/C layout
A/B: lane%16 = m-row for A / n-col for B (K axis split by lane/16)
D/C: lane%16 = n-col for D / m-row axis split by lane/16 instead
→ Chained WMMA (MLP): must store D to shared memory, then reload as B.
lane%16 maps to different dimensions in the two layouts.
Matrix A (16×16, Column-Major) — Lane Coverage Map
Row m is covered by Lane m (k=0..7) and Lane m+16 (k=8..15). Each lane holds 8 unique FP16 values (half8_t).
